idea-plugin.name: Claude Code [Kit]
idea-plugin.description:
Claude Code [Kit] brings the Claude CLI into your JetBrains IDE — both for generating commit messages and for feeding file references straight into a Claude Code session running in the terminal.

Features
  • Generate commit messages — a button on the commit panel toolbar sends the files checked for the commit to Claude, which inspects the diffs itself via read-only git commands and fills the generated message into the commit message field. The output language can follow the IDE or be pinned to Chinese/English, and your own prompt is appended to the built-in commit conventions.
  • Copy / Send CC reference — right-click in the editor or the project view (or press Ctrl+Alt+K, Cmd+Alt+K on macOS) to build a Claude Code reference for the current file and selection (@path#Lstart-end) and either copy it to the clipboard or type it into the terminal.
    Send types the reference into only the currently active terminal tab. This deliberately differs from the official Claude Code [Beta] plugin, whose shortcut broadcasts the reference to every open Claude session at once — so you can keep several Claude sessions side by side and reference a file into exactly the one you mean.
  • Auto-open Claude Code — when you send a reference and no terminal is open, a new terminal is created, the Claude CLI is launched in it, and the reference is typed in automatically (on by default; can be turned off).
  • Switch terminal tabs with Cmd+1…9 — while the focus is inside the Terminal tool window, Cmd+N (Alt+N on Windows/Linux) selects the N-th terminal tab instead of opening the numbered tool window. Anywhere else, when there is no N-th tab, and when that tab is already the selected one, the IDE keeps its own behavior — so pressing the same shortcut again opens the numbered tool window as usual (on by default; can be turned off).
  • Switch project windows with Option+1…9 (macOS) — Option+N brings the N-th open project window to the front and moves the focus into it, numbered the way the IDE's own Window menu lists them (by project name), so the numbers stay put across restarts. It works from inside the terminal too, so you can jump between projects without leaving a Claude Code session (on by default). On Windows/Linux the actions ship without a shortcut, since Alt+1…9 belongs to the IDE tool windows there — bind your own under Settings > Keymap.
    Note: on non-US Mac keyboard layouts Option+digit is how some characters are typed (German { } = Option+8/9, Spanish @ = Option+2). The shortcut takes those keystrokes over — turn the option off if you need them.
  • Bilingual UI — the interface and settings follow the IDE display language (English or Simplified Chinese).
  • Close terminal before the project closes — an optional convenience that closes the Terminal tool window on the way out, so a terminal whose shell is already gone is not restored the next time the project opens.
Configurable under Settings > Tools > Claude Code [Kit] (Claude CLI path, API URL/key, model, timeout, custom prompt, and the terminal options above). The CC reference and auto-open features require the bundled Terminal plugin. Requires IDE 2025.3.6 or newer.
Claude Code [Kit] 把 Claude CLI 集成进你的 JetBrains IDE——既能生成 Git 提交消息, 也能把文件引用直接送进终端里运行的 Claude Code 会话。

功能
  • 生成提交消息——提交面板工具栏上的一个按钮,把本次勾选提交的文件交给 Claude, 它自己用只读的 git 命令查看差异,并把生成的消息填回提交消息框。输出语言可跟随 IDE,也可固定 为中文/英文;你的自定义提示词会追加在内置的提交约定之后。
  • 复制 / 发送 CC 引用——在编辑器或项目视图中右键(或按 Ctrl+Alt+K,macOS 为 Cmd+Alt+K),为当前文件与选区生成 Claude Code 引用(@path#Lstart-end),复制到 剪贴板或输入到终端。
    发送只会把引用输入到当前激活的终端标签页。这一点有意区别于官方的 Claude Code [Beta] 插件——后者的快捷键会把引用同时广播到所有已打开的 Claude 会话; 因此你可以并排开多个 Claude 会话,把文件引用精确发送到你想要的那一个。
  • 自动打开 Claude Code——发送引用时如果没有打开的终端,会自动新建终端、在其中启动 Claude CLI,并把引用输入进去(默认开启,可关闭)。
  • Cmd+1~9 切换终端标签页——焦点在终端工具窗内时,Cmd+N(Windows/Linux 为 Alt+N) 切换到第 N 个终端标签页,而不是打开对应编号的工具窗。焦点在别处、没有第 N 个标签页、 或已经在第 N 个标签页时,仍保持 IDE 原有行为——所以再按一次同样的快捷键,会照常打开 对应编号的工具窗(默认开启,可关闭)。
  • Option+1~9 切换项目窗口(macOS)——Option+N 把第 N 个已打开的项目窗口切到前台 并把焦点移进去,编号与 IDE 自带的 Window 菜单一致(按项目名排序),重启后编号也不会变。 焦点在终端里时同样生效,因此不用离开 Claude Code 会话就能 在多个项目之间跳转(默认开启,可关闭)。Windows/Linux 上 Alt+1~9 属于 IDE 工具窗,故不预设 快捷键,可在 Settings > Keymap 中自行绑定。
    注意:在非美式 Mac 键盘布局上,Option+数字是输入字符用的(德语 { } = Option+8/9,西班牙语 @ = Option+2)。本快捷键会接管这些按键,需要它们的话请关闭 该选项。
  • 中英双语界面——界面与设置跟随 IDE 显示语言(英文或简体中文)。
  • 关闭项目前关闭终端——一个可选的便捷项,在项目关闭时先关掉终端工具窗,这样其 shell 已不存在的空终端下次打开项目时就不会再被恢复出来。
可在 Settings > Tools > Claude Code [Kit] 中配置(Claude CLI 路径、API 地址/密钥、 模型、超时、自定义提示词,以及上述终端选项)。CC 引用与自动打开功能需要启用捆绑的终端插件。 需要 IDE 2025.3.6 或更高版本。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.5.1 — Option+1…9 project switching made reliable. Option+N now invokes the N-th entry of the IDE's own Window menu, so the numbering is the menu's (by project name) instead of the order the windows happened to finish opening in — which shifted between restarts and whenever a project was closed — and the switch moves the focus into the target window, where it previously could raise the window without taking the focus. Inside the terminal the shortcut no longer goes dead or starts typing into the shell after a project window is opened or closed. The number of the window you are already in re-focuses it instead of typing a stray character (Option+1 = "¡") into the editor.

1.5.0 — Option+1…9 (macOS) switch to the N-th open project window, numbered in the order the windows were opened. The shortcut also works while the focus is inside the Terminal tool window, so a Claude Code session no longer has to be left behind to switch projects.

1.4.1 — Cmd/Alt+N no longer swallows the keystroke when the N-th terminal tab is already the selected one: the shortcut falls through to the IDE, so pressing Cmd+1 again while on the first terminal tab activates the Project tool window as usual instead of doing nothing.

1.4.0 — The auto-close terminal option now runs when the project closes instead of when it opens: the Terminal is hidden before the layout is saved, so it is never restored and no longer flashes open on startup. The setting was renamed accordingly; existing enabled settings migrate automatically.

1.3.1 — Renamed the plugin to Claude Code [Kit] (was "Claude Code Commit"), matching the naming style of the official Claude Code [Beta] plugin. No functional changes.

1.3.0 — Cmd+1…9 (Alt+1…9 on Windows/Linux) switch to the N-th terminal tab while the Terminal tool window has the focus. Elsewhere, and when the tab does not exist, the IDE's own "Activate <X> Tool Window" still runs.

1.2.0 — Optional setting to auto-close the Terminal tool window when a project opens (independent of commit-message generation; requires the Terminal plugin). Kept in its own group on the settings page.

1.1.0 — Editor popup menu actions "复制 CC 引用" (copies a Claude Code reference, @path#Lstart-end, for the current file and selection) and "发送 CC 引用" (types the reference into the active terminal tab).

1.0.1 — Save API Key in plugin settings.

1.0.0 — Initial release: commit-panel button, Claude CLI integration, tag-based message extraction, customizable prompt.
